title: UAPI stability: GET_STATE omits inbuf_pending for UNSET fds
description: crypto2dev_fd_state_info.inbuf_pending is not populated by ioctl_get_state for CRYPTO2DEV_FDTYPE_UNSET fds. An UNSET fd can accumulate write() data in state->inbuf (for subsequent KEY_IMPORT or DO_KDF). Userspace has no way to query how many bytes have been buffered via GET_STATE on an UNSET fd — inbuf_pending is left zero even when state->inbuf_len > 0. This matters for diagnostic tools and for callers that want to confirm their write() data was received before issuing KEY_IMPORT.
